exams.name: Podiatrist Licensure Examination
exams.notes: Written or oral tests, or both, requiring minimum competency in subjects substantially related to the practice of podiatry. Up to 2 reexaminations permitted; further examination requires reapplication and evidence of additional education or training.
exams.jurisdiction: state (administered or arranged by the affiliated credentialing board)
exams.quote: The affiliated credentialing board shall conduct or arrange for examinations for podiatrist licensure at least semiannually

required.quote: Renewal applications shall be submitted to the department on a form provided by the department and shall be accompanied by all of the following: ... (b) Proof of completion of continuing education requirements in s. 448.665.

available.quote: The affiliated credentialing board may waive the requirement under sub. (1) (d) 1. for an applicant who establishes ... That he or she is licensed as a podiatrist by another licensing jurisdiction in the United States.

requirements.value: Applicant must be a graduate of a podiatry school, be licensed as a podiatrist by another U.S. licensing jurisdiction, the jurisdiction must have required graduation from an approved school or one evaluated for education equivalency, and the applicant must have actively practiced for at least 3 years immediately preceding the application.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Act or attempted act of commission or omission as defined by the affiliated credentialing board by rule, or a violation of pharmacy or controlled substances law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: "Unprofessional conduct" means an act or attempted act of commission or omission, as defined by the affiliated credentialing board by rule under s. 448.695 (1), or an act by a podiatrist in violation of ch. 450 or 961.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Giving or receiving any fee, commission, rebate, or compensation for referrals or for services not personally rendered.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No licensee may give or receive, directly or indirectly, to or from any other person any fee, commission, rebate or other form of compensation or anything of value for sending, referring or otherwise inducing a person to communicate with a licensee in a professional capacity, or for any professional services not actually rendered personally by the licensee or at the licensee's direction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to render an individual statement of charges directly to the patient, distinct from statements by other providers.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a licensee who renders any podiatric service or assistance ... shall ... render an individual statement or account of the charge directly to the patient, distinct and separate from any statement or account by any other podiatrist, physician, physician assistant, advanced practice registered nurse, or other person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing podiatry without having a license under this subchapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a person who practices podiatry without having a license under this subchapter may be liable for malpractice

definition_quote.value: Podiatry or podiatric medicine and surgery means that branch or system of the practice of medicine and surgery that involves treating the sick which is limited to conditions affecting the foot and ankle, but does not include the use of a general anesthetic unless administered by or under the direction of a person licensed to practice medicine and surgery under subch. II.

advanced_practice_nurse_collaboration_au.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse who is providing nonsurgical patient services as directed, supervised, and inspected by a podiatrist who has the power to direct, decide, and oversee the implementation of the patient services rendered.

impaired_practitioner_program.quote: The department shall promulgate rules specifying a procedure for addressing allegations that a credential holder has practiced while impaired by alcohol or other drugs or that his or her ability to practice is impaired by alcohol or other drugs, and for assisting a credential holder who requests to participate in the procedure.
